semiconductor_relevance: High — Pinason provides critical equipment and technical solutions for semiconductor processing systems, including inspection, measurement, and wafer processing.
summary: Pinason (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. specializes in providing remanufactured equipment and technical solutions for semiconductor processing systems. The company offers a comprehensive range of products including inspection and measurement equipment, wafer processing systems, and substrate metrology tools. Their expertise extends to cleaning, deposition, and etching equipment, ensuring high-quality solutions for semiconductor fabrication processes.
capabilities: Inspection and measurement systems for topology and nanotopography
Cleaning, washing, and drying equipment for substrates
Deposition equipment including PVD, sputtering, and evaporation systems

regional_presence.China: Headquartered in Shanghai, focusing on providing semiconductor equipment and solutions.
